data_sources.name: usgs_nga_gmted2010
data_sources.label: GMTED2010
data_sources.producer_institution: U.S. Geological Survey; National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency
data_sources.description: Static multi-source terrain compilation, published 2011. Horizontal WGS84; predominant vertical EGM96 with provider-documented source exceptions. Compilation label 2010 is not observation year. Source acquisition dates, coverage and accuracy vary; nominal angular spacing is not constant ground metres. USGS public-domain data; cite Danielson and Gesch (2011), USGS Open-File Report 2011-1073.
data_sources.citation_apa: Danielson, J.J., and Gesch, D.B. (2011). Global Multi-resolution Terrain Elevation Data 2010 (GMTED2010). USGS Open-File Report 2011-1073. https://doi.org/10.3133/ofr20111073

products.name: gmted2010_be15_arcgrid
products.label: GMTED2010 Breakline Emphasis 15 arcsec
products.description: Original provider Arc/Info binary grid (AIG), not ASCII Grid. Native archive metadata for this exact variant verifies dimensions, geotransform, WGS84 and Int16 nodata -32768. AIG has no existing accurate format enum; native_format is intentionally unset. No scale or offset supplied: valid signed elevations are metres, negative elevations and zero are valid. GMTED standard deviation measures sub-cell elevation variation, not DEM accuracy or absolute elevation. Native GeoTIFF sample metadata independently corroborates every statistic/resolution; TIFF tile extent is not the full ArcGrid extent. Angular grids retain a half-arcsecond offset; do not snap to -180/90. Thirty-arcsecond mean/subsample grids have 20880 rows, others 16800; finer archives have 33600/67200 rows. Not all statistic/resolution combinations share polar coverage. Floating writer differences below 0.001 cell across the domain share one GridDefinition; each exact native geotransform is retained in arcgrid_native.json. No synthetic time interval is assigned.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Native archive extent; land coverage and polar fill vary by statistic/resolution
